problems.title: Sign-up shows "1 of 6" up front and puts the account last; both cold-start personas quit or nearly quit in setup
problems.summary: The reworked /start (goals → what Lumi can do → university → discover → communities → account) still has six screens before an account. Jordan quit on screen 4 (a second interest picker); Diego skipped twice and arrived with most patience spent.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: Profiling before value; "1 of 6" makes the length explicit; the discover picker repeats the goals screen; the tour opens on Classes even after "Meet new people".

evidence.quote: four screens in and I haven't seen a single human. this is the part where I delete it.
1 of 6?? six screens before I even see anything. ugh.
I said meet people. why are you showing me calculus. skip.
Still no account. I'm hitting Skip. Nine taps in and I haven't seen a single person.

problems.suggestedFix: Drop or merge the discover picker into goals; open the tour on the tab matching the chosen goal; show something real (this week on campus) before the optional screens.

problems.environmentNote: Local stack has no other students; real at quiet times on live.
problems.title: A brand-new account finds nobody to meet: Meetups says "Make the first plan"
problems.summary: Diego quit on empty Meetups; only official events with "Go together" below.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: No fallback for an empty campus except hosting.

evidence.quote: Nobody's made a plan. I'm new, I'm not gonna be the first to host.

problems.suggestedFix: Low-pressure "count me in for lunch/coffee this week" signal instead of "make the first plan".

problems.environmentNote: Members empty is partly local (no other students); events/organizers come from the same imported data as live — likely the same there.
problems.title: Club pages are empty past the join button: no dated events, no members, organizers "not on Lumi yet"
problems.summary: Jordan (Cal Hacks) and Minji (KSA): Events, Members and About tabs empty; "Organizers aren't on Lumi yet · requests are saved and passed on" made them doubt anyone reads the request. Same problem as 2026-11-02.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: Clubs come from official lists without officers; the page shows empty tabs instead of the club's own links and meeting times.

evidence.quote: no events. for the biggest hackathon club. so nothing happening.
organizers aren't even here? so I'm asking... nobody?
3 tabs, 다 비었어. so the only real thing here is the Ask to join button

problems.suggestedFix: Hide empty tabs; show the club's official site/Instagram and usual meeting time; say exactly who receives the request (e.g. "we email the officers listed on CalLink").

problems.title: Club list "Recommended" is effectively alphabetical: sororities and consulting clubs first, no photos or what's on
problems.summary: Minji saw Alpha Chi Omega first under "Recommended"; Jordan saw a text-only directory led by consulting clubs. Both found their club only by searching. Third and fourth persona on this problem.
problems.rootCauseHypothesis: Recommended ignores the student's picks; list rows have no activity signal.

evidence.quote: 'Recommended' is just alphabet sororities? 뭐지. I'm not rushing a sorority at 17
94 groups. no pics, no 'meeting tonight'. kinda bulletin board.

problems.suggestedFix: Rank by the student's goals/communities picks; show a "meets Thursdays" or "event this week" line where known.

dismissed.reason: Single sev-1 wording nit ("Followed is different from verified membership").

harnessIssues.title: tap-target auto-checks noisy
harnessIssues.detail: Several runs flag header icons and the 23px-tall search input as <44px; worth one aggregated design ticket rather than per-run noise.
